image_processing: Official defaults; no pixel override or manual downsampling
request_timing: In-memory RGB image to returned Python decision, synchronized CUDA boundaries; includes rendering, tokenization, image preprocessing, input hashing, H2D, model, and readout; excludes model loading, image file I/O, JSON log writes, cold/compile and warmup requests.
model_gpu_timing: CUDA events after H2D and before result D2H; includes any GPU idle time between host launches; not an isolated kernel profiler.
scope: One fictional example repeated for latency; no accuracy or probability-calibration claim.
